subject.title: [Bug 6.1] Silent config auto-patch from memory-core + error-message auto-fix breaks all cron jobs on hosts without Docker

question: What boundary should OpenClaw enforce for protected config writes that are reachable through assistant-visible errors, host exec, plugins, or cron housekeeping?
rationale: The remaining fix is not a single mechanical bug because it changes who may mutate persisted security config and how operator-only repair advice is separated from model-visible errors.

options.title: Enforce explicit operator provenance
options.body: Recommended: remove protected config assignments from assistant-visible errors and require explicit operator provenance or approval before protected CLI/plugin/cron config writes can persist.

options.title: Text-only mitigation
options.body: Land a narrow copy change that removes executable-looking sandbox suggestions, while keeping a separate issue open for CLI-through-exec and plugin provenance.

options.title: Request reporter logs first
options.body: Keep the issue in needs-info state until the exact auto-writer is identified from logs before changing config mutation behavior.

recommendation.title: Enforce explicit operator provenance
recommendation.body: Recommended: remove protected config assignments from assistant-visible errors and require explicit operator provenance or approval before protected CLI/plugin/cron config writes can persist.

likelyOwner.reason: The current guarded gateway config-write boundary was authored in the area jacobtomlinson changed, making that history the closest match for this decision.
